Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. 1. Design, printing/fabrication, supply and installation/fixing of hospital signages at various loca tions of National Institute of Homoeopathy (NIH), Kolkata, as and when required during the contract period. 2. The signages shall generally cover the following categories: a) Patient guidance and public information signages. b) Patient rights, responsibilities and NABH-related signages. c) Emergency, fire safety and evacuation signages. d) Departmental and clinical area signages. e) IPD, ward and bed-number signages. f) Administrative and support-service signages. g) Breast-feeding room and other patient-facility signages. h) Awareness, policy and statutory display boards. i) Any other signages as per requirement of the Institute. 3. The signages shall be provided in Hindi, Bengali and English (trilingual), wherever specified by the u ser department. The trilingual requirement is to be incorporated through the technical specifications/ATC s ince it is not available as a standard selectable specification on GeM. 4. The work may include signages made from different materials such as: a) Acrylic b) Sun board c) Flex d) Other materials as specifically approved/required by the Institute. 5. The contractor shall undertake printing, fabrication, finishing, transportation, delivery and instal lation/fixing, wherever applicable, at the locations specified by NIH. 6. The size, dimensions, design, content, material and quantity of individual signages shall be deter mined by the concerned user department based on the actual site requirement at the time of placing indiv idual supply orders. 7. The contractor shall provide signages at different locations including OPDs, IPD/wards, emergency ar eas, public utility areas, administrative offices, clinical departments, corridors, staircases, lifts and other hospital premises, as directed by the Institute. 8. The work shall also include replacement/re-fabrication of damaged, worn-out or unserviceable si gnages and provision of new signages arising from renovation, departmental shifting, creation of new facilities, NABH observations or statutory requirements. 9. Emergency and safety signages, including fire exits, emergency exit routes, night-glow signages, stai rcase/lift identification and safety/warning boards, shall be fabricated and installed as per the requirement

s communicated by the user department. 10. The contractor shall ensure that the supplied signages are of good quality, properly finished, legible, durable and suitable for the intended location and purpose. 11. The contractor shall carry out the work on a requirement-based call/order system throughout the on e-year ARC period. There shall be no obligation on the Institute to procure the indicative quantity mention ed in the proposal. 12. Payment shall be made on the basis of the actual measured area (Sq. Ft./Sq. Mtr., as applicable) of the signages supplied and accepted by NIH at the approved ARC rate. 13. The quoted rate shall be all-inclusive, covering material, printing, fabrication, finishing, transportation, i nstallation/fixing, labour, GST, duties and all other incidental charges necessary for satisfactory completio n of the work. 14. The contractor shall coordinate with the concerned user department/authorized representative of NIH for finalization of artwork, content, dimensions, location and installation requirements before executio n. 15. The design and proofreading have to be done by the agency. 16. Availability of office of service provider: An office of service provider must be located in Kolkata, West Be ngal. Documents of evidence must be submitted. 17. Any dispute arising out of this contract shall be resolved amicably, in case of failure to resolve it will be re ferred to sole arbitrator as may be appointed by the Director, NIH. All works shall be completed within the time specified in the individual supply/work order issued by NI H under the ARC. . 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Payment online through RTGS / internet banking also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). On-line payment shall be in Beneficiary name National Institute of Homoeopathy Account No. 29460100009011 IFSC Code BARB0SALCAL (5TH character is zero) Bank Name Bank of Baroda Branch address HA-10, Sector - III, Salt Lake, Kolkata - 700097 . Successful Bidder to indicate Contract number and name of Seller entity in the transaction details field at the time of on-line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer in place of PBG within 15 days of award of contract. 7. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 8. Service & Support

Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 9. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 10. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid.
